SELECT MAX(public_track.unit_price) AS max_unit_price FROM (SELECT public_track.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track

SELECT public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name, public_employee.title FROM (SELECT __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name, __source.title AS title FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS public_employee WHERE LOWER(public_employee.title) = LOWER('Sales Support Agent')

SELECT COUNT(public_invoice.invoice_id) AS total_invoices FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.invoice_id FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.invoice_id AS invoice_id FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)

SELECT public_customer.first_name AS "First Name", public_customer.last_name AS "Last Name", public_customer.company AS "Company" FROM (SELECT public_customer.company, public_customer.first_name, public_customer.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.company AS company, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS public_customer WHERE NOT public_customer.company IS NULL

SELECT public_genre."name" AS "Genre Name", public_genre.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1."name", __relation__1.track_count FROM (SELECT track_count.genre_id, public_genre."name", track_count.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.genre_id AS genre_id, COUNT(__relation__1.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track) AS public_track RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre ON public_track.genre_id = public_genre.genre_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.genre_id) AS track_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre ON track_count.genre_id = public_genre.genre_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_genre ORDER BY public_genre."name" ASC

SELECT public_artist."name", public_artist.album_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.album_count, __relation__1."name" FROM (SELECT album_count.album_count, public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __relation__1.artist_id AS artist_id, COUNT(__relation__1.album_id) AS album_count FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_artist.artist_id FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS public_album) AS public_album RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist ON public_album.artist_id = public_artist.artist_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.artist_id) AS album_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist ON album_count.artist_id = public_artist.artist_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_artist ORDER BY public_artist.album_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT public_invoice.billing_country, SUM(public_invoice.total) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT public_invoice.billing_country, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.billing_country AS billing_country, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice GROUP BY public_invoice.billing_country ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT public_customer.first_name AS "First Name", public_customer.last_name AS "Last Name" FROM (SELECT public_customer.first_name, public_customer.last_name, public_customer.support_rep_id FROM (SELECT __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name, __source.support_rep_id AS support_rep_id FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS public_customer INNER JOIN (SELECT public_employee.employee_id, public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.employee_id AS employee_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS public_employee ON public_customer.support_rep_id = public_employee.employee_id WHERE LOWER(public_employee.first_name) = LOWER('Jane') AND LOWER(public_employee.last_name) = LOWER('Peacock')

SELECT public_media_type."name" AS "Media_Type_Name", ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(public_track."milliseconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60000.0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "Average_Length_Minutes" FROM (SELECT public_track.media_type_id, public_track."milliseconds" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."milliseconds" AS "milliseconds" FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track INNER JOIN (SELECT public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".media_type AS __source) AS public_media_type) AS public_media_type ON public_track.media_type_id = public_media_type.media_type_id GROUP BY public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name"

SELECT public_album.title, public_album.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.title, __relation__1.track_count FROM (SELECT track_count.album_id, public_album.title, track_count.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.album_id AS album_id, COUNT(__relation__1.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track) AS public_track RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album ON public_track.album_id = public_album.album_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.album_id) AS track_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.title AS title FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album ON track_count.album_id = public_album.album_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_album WHERE public_album.track_count > 20

SELECT public_genre."name" FROM (SELECT __relation__1."name", __relation__1.track_count FROM (SELECT track_count.genre_id, public_genre."name", track_count.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.genre_id AS genre_id, COUNT(__relation__1.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track) AS public_track RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre ON public_track.genre_id = public_genre.genre_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.genre_id) AS track_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre ON track_count.genre_id = public_genre.genre_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_genre ORDER BY public_genre.track_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(pt.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_playlist."name", public_playlist.playlist_id FROM (SELECT __source."name" AS "name", __source.playlist_id AS playlist_id FROM chinook."public".playlist AS __source) AS public_playlist) AS p INNER JOIN (SELECT public_playlist_track.playlist_id, public_playlist_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.playlist_id AS playlist_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".playlist_track AS __source) AS public_playlist_track) AS pt ON p.playlist_id = pt.playlist_id WHERE LOWER(p."name") = LOWER('90’s Music')

SELECT monthly."month", monthly.revenue AS total_invoice_revenue, LAG(monthly.revenue) OVER (ORDER BY monthly."month" ASC) AS previous_month_revenue FROM (SELECT CAST(DATE_PART('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date) AS INT) AS "month", SUM(public_invoice.total) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY DATE_PART('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date)) AS monthly ORDER BY monthly."month" ASC

SELECT artist_genres."name", artist_genres.genre_count FROM (SELECT a.artist_id, a."name", COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) AS genre_count FROM (SELECT public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS al ON a.artist_id = al.artist_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.genre_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.genre_id AS genre_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON al.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY a.artist_id, a."name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) > 3) AS artist_genres ORDER BY artist_genres.genre_count DESC NULLS LAST, artist_genres."name" ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il WHERE il.track_id = t.track_id)

SELECT e.first_name AS employee_first_name, e.last_name AS employee_last_name, m.first_name AS manager_first_name, m.last_name AS manager_last_name FROM (SELECT public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name, public_employee.reports_to FROM (SELECT __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name, __source.reports_to AS reports_to FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS e INNER JOIN (SELECT public_employee.employee_id, public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.employee_id AS employee_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE NOT e.reports_to IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i2025.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.invoice_date FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i2025 WHERE CAST(i2025.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(i2025.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.invoice_date FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i2024 WHERE i2024.customer_id = i2025.customer_id AND CAST(i2024.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(i2024.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))

SELECT "Month", "Cumulative_Total" FROM (SELECT monthly.month_start AS "Month", SUM(monthly.month_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY monthly.month_start ASC) AS "Cumulative_Total", monthly.month_start FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS month_start, SUM(public_invoice.total) AS month_revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) AS monthly ORDER BY monthly.month_start ASC)

SELECT rbm."name" AS media_type_name, ROUND(CAST(CAST(CAST((CAST((rbm.media_rev * 100.0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tr.total_rev) AS DECIMAL(38, 10)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage_of_total_sales FROM (SELECT mt.media_type_id, mt."name", SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS media_rev FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.media_type_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".media_type AS __source) AS public_media_type) AS mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.media_type_id, mt."name") AS rbm CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS total_rev FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il) AS tr ORDER BY rbm."name" ASC

SELECT artist_revenue.artist_name, artist_revenue.revenue FROM (SELECT a.artist_id, a."name" AS artist_name, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS al ON t.album_id = al.album_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist) AS a ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY a.artist_id, a."name") AS artist_revenue ORDER BY artist_revenue.revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "count(*)" FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)

SELECT public_customer.first_name AS "First Name", public_customer.last_name AS "Last Name", public_customer.company AS "Company" FROM (SELECT public_customer.company, public_customer.first_name, public_customer.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.company AS company, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS public_customer WHERE NOT public_customer.company IS NULL

SELECT public_genre."name" AS "Genre Name", COUNT(public_track.track_id) AS "Track Count" FROM (SELECT public_genre.genre_id, public_genre."name" FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre) AS public_genre INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track ON public_genre.genre_id = public_track.genre_id GROUP BY public_genre.genre_id, public_genre."name" ORDER BY public_genre."name" ASC

SELECT public_artist."name" AS "Artist Name", public_artist.album_count AS "Album Count" FROM (SELECT __relation__1.album_count, __relation__1."name" FROM (SELECT album_count.album_count, public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __relation__1.artist_id AS artist_id, COUNT(__relation__1.album_id) AS album_count FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_artist.artist_id FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS public_album) AS public_album RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist ON public_album.artist_id = public_artist.artist_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.artist_id) AS album_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist ON album_count.artist_id = public_artist.artist_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_artist ORDER BY public_artist.album_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT public_invoice.billing_country, SUM(public_invoice.total) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT public_invoice.billing_country, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.billing_country AS billing_country, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice GROUP BY public_invoice.billing_country ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT c.first_name AS "First Name", c.last_name AS "Last Name" FROM (SELECT public_customer.first_name, public_customer.last_name, public_customer.support_rep_id FROM (SELECT __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name, __source.support_rep_id AS support_rep_id FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT public_employee.employee_id FROM (SELECT public_employee.employee_id, public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.employee_id AS employee_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS public_employee WHERE LOWER(public_employee.first_name) = LOWER('Jane') AND LOWER(public_employee.last_name) = LOWER('Peacock')) AS e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id

SELECT public_media_type."name" AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(public_track."milliseconds" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 60000.0) AS average_length_minutes FROM (SELECT public_track.media_type_id, public_track."milliseconds" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."milliseconds" AS "milliseconds" FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track INNER JOIN (SELECT public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".media_type AS __source) AS public_media_type) AS public_media_type ON public_track.media_type_id = public_media_type.media_type_id GROUP BY public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name" ORDER BY public_media_type."name" ASC

SELECT public_album.title, public_album.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.title, __relation__1.track_count FROM (SELECT track_count.album_id, public_album.title, track_count.track_count FROM (SELECT __relation__1.album_id AS album_id, COUNT(__relation__1.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track) AS public_track RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album ON public_track.album_id = public_album.album_id) AS __relation__1 GROUP BY __relation__1.album_id) AS track_count RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.title AS title FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album ON track_count.album_id = public_album.album_id) AS __relation__1) AS public_album WHERE public_album.track_count > 20

SELECT genre_counts."name" FROM (SELECT g."name", COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_genre.genre_id, public_genre."name" FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre) AS g INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g."name") AS genre_counts ORDER BY genre_counts.track_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT p."name" AS "Playlist Name", COUNT(pt.track_id) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_playlist.playlist_id, public_playlist."name" FROM (SELECT public_playlist."name", public_playlist.playlist_id FROM (SELECT __source."name" AS "name", __source.playlist_id AS playlist_id FROM chinook."public".playlist AS __source) AS public_playlist) AS public_playlist WHERE LOWER(public_playlist."name") = LOWER('90’s Music')) AS p INNER JOIN (SELECT public_playlist_track.playlist_id, public_playlist_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.playlist_id AS playlist_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".playlist_track AS __source) AS public_playlist_track) AS pt ON p.playlist_id = pt.playlist_id GROUP BY p.playlist_id, p."name"

SELECT DATE_PART('YEAR', public_invoice.invoice_date) AS "year", SUM(public_invoice.total) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice GROUP BY DATE_PART('YEAR', public_invoice.invoice_date) ORDER BY "year" ASC

SELECT public_genre."name" AS genre_name, SUM(public_invoice_line.unit_price * public_invoice_line.quantity) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS public_invoice_line INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.genre_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS public_track ON public_invoice_line.track_id = public_track.track_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_genre.genre_id, public_genre."name" FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre) AS public_genre ON public_track.genre_id = public_genre.genre_id GROUP BY public_genre.genre_id, public_genre."name" ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total FROM (SELECT public_employee.employee_id, public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.employee_id AS employee_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS e INNER JOIN (SELECT public_customer.customer_id, public_customer.support_rep_id FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.support_rep_id AS support_rep_id FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS c ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT ranked.country, ranked.first_name, ranked.last_name, ranked.total_spend FROM (SELECT customer_spend.country, customer_spend.first_name, customer_spend.last_name, customer_spend.total_spend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_spend.country ORDER BY customer_spend.total_spend DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rank" FROM (SELECT c.country, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total_spend FROM (SELECT public_customer.country, public_customer.customer_id, public_customer.first_name, public_customer.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.country AS country, __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".customer AS __source) AS public_customer) AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.country, c.first_name, c.last_name) AS customer_spend) AS ranked WHERE ranked."rank" = 1

SELECT monthly.month_number, monthly.revenue, LAG(monthly.revenue) OVER (ORDER BY monthly.month_number ASC) AS previous_month_revenue FROM (SELECT CAST(DATE_PART('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date) AS INT) AS month_number, SUM(public_invoice.total) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY DATE_PART('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date)) AS monthly ORDER BY monthly.month_number ASC

SELECT artist_genre_counts."Artist Name", artist_genre_counts.genre_count FROM (SELECT a.artist_id, a."name" AS "Artist Name", COUNT(DISTINCT g.genre_id) AS genre_count FROM (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.genre_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.genre_id AS genre_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t INNER JOIN (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS al ON t.album_id = al.album_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist) AS a ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_genre.genre_id FROM (SELECT __source.genre_id AS genre_id FROM chinook."public".genre AS __source) AS public_genre) AS g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY a.artist_id, a."name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.genre_id) > 3) AS artist_genre_counts

SELECT COUNT(1) AS track_count FROM (SELECT public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT public_invoice_line.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il ON t.track_id = il.track_id WHERE il.track_id IS NULL

SELECT e.first_name AS "First Name", e.last_name AS "Last Name", m.first_name AS "Manager First Name", m.last_name AS "Manager Last Name" FROM (SELECT public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name, public_employee.reports_to FROM (SELECT __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name, __source.reports_to AS reports_to FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS e INNER JOIN (SELECT public_employee.employee_id, public_employee.first_name, public_employee.last_name FROM (SELECT __source.employee_id AS employee_id, __source.first_name AS first_name, __source.last_name AS last_name FROM chinook."public".employee AS __source) AS public_employee) AS m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE NOT e.reports_to IS NULL ORDER BY e.last_name ASC, e.first_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i2025.customer_id) FROM (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.invoice_date FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i2025 WHERE CAST(i2025.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(i2025.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT public_invoice.customer_id, public_invoice.invoice_date FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS i2024 WHERE i2024.customer_id = i2025.customer_id AND CAST(i2024.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(i2024.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))

SELECT monthly.month_start, SUM(monthly.month_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY monthly.month_start ASC) AS running_total FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date) AS month_start, SUM(public_invoice.total) AS month_revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice.invoice_date, public_invoice.total FROM (SELECT __source.invoice_date AS invoice_date, __source.total AS total FROM chinook."public".invoice AS __source) AS public_invoice) AS public_invoice WHERE CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(public_invoice.invoice_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', public_invoice.invoice_date)) AS monthly ORDER BY monthly.month_start ASC

SELECT mr.media_type_name, ROUND(CAST(CAST(CAST(((CAST(mr.revenue AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tr.total) * 100) AS DECIMAL(38, 10)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM (SELECT mt."name" AS media_type_name, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.media_type_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_media_type.media_type_id, public_media_type."name" FROM (SELECT __source.media_type_id AS media_type_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".media_type AS __source) AS public_media_type) AS mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.media_type_id, mt."name") AS mr CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS total FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il) AS tr ORDER BY mr.media_type_name ASC

SELECT artist_revenue.artist_name, artist_revenue.revenue FROM (SELECT a."name" AS artist_name, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM (SELECT public_invoice_line.quantity, public_invoice_line.track_id, public_invoice_line.unit_price FROM (SELECT __source.quantity AS quantity, __source.track_id AS track_id, __source.unit_price AS unit_price FROM chinook."public".invoice_line AS __source) AS public_invoice_line) AS il INNER JOIN (SELECT public_track.album_id, public_track.track_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.track_id AS track_id FROM chinook."public".track AS __source) AS public_track) AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_album.album_id, public_album.artist_id FROM (SELECT __source.album_id AS album_id, __source.artist_id AS artist_id FROM chinook."public".album AS __source) AS public_album) AS al ON t.album_id = al.album_id INNER JOIN (SELECT public_artist.artist_id, public_artist."name" FROM (SELECT __source.artist_id AS artist_id, __source."name" AS "name" FROM chinook."public".artist AS __source) AS public_artist) AS a ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY a.artist_id, a."name") AS artist_revenue ORDER BY artist_revenue.revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
